fixed_factors: reviewed snapshot, split and event-weight hashes
letterboxed actor RGB preprocessing and packed cache
backbone unless backbone is the declared factor
optimizer and training budget unless declared

development_scope.selection_roles: inner-development roles derived only from outer-training populations

stages.name: authority_and_engineering_preflight
stages.scientific_question: Are existing reviewed data, view, feature, loader, checkpoint, evaluator and checker contracts reusable under the corrected route?
stages.control: hash-bound current authority and independent checkers
stages.changed_factor: route semantics and orchestration validation only
stages.promotion_rule: all required contracts validate; no training
stages.stop_rule: stop on authority conflict, hash mismatch, forbidden input, or missing exact-view binding

stages.name: temporal_view_screening
stages.scientific_question: Which registered pooled temporal view is strongest under one fixed sequential reference?
stages.control: existing B1 actor RGB sequence reference with all controls fixed
stages.historical_diagnostic: S6@16 is legacy-only and cannot enter pooled selection
stages.promotion_rule: promote at most two views; do not lock one view from one noisy seed when the top two are close; require confirmation stability
stages.stop_rule: drop a view for coverage failure, exact-view failure, or repeated rare-class/common-class harm

compute.basis: extrapolated from current bounded real resume; recalibrate in E0

stages.name: feature_family_ablation
stages.scientific_question: Which structured feature families add evidence beyond actor-centered RGB on the promoted view or views?
stages.control: F0 actor-centered RGB on each promoted view
stages.confirmation_policy: confirm only the predeclared top four arms across two additional seeds
stages.promotion_rule: retain only families with matched evidence or an explicitly useful guardrail/calibration trade-off; null and negative results are valid
stages.stop_rule: stop an arm on feature isolation failure, coverage loss, or uncontrolled factor drift

compute.basis: extrapolated; exact-view cache and E0 throughput must replace this estimate

stages.name: imbalance_treatment
stages.scientific_question: Which small registered imbalance treatment improves rare classes without common-class collapse?
stages.confirmation_policy: confirm at most the top two across two additional seeds
stages.promotion_rule: select the simplest strategy meeting the primary metric and rare-class guards with fold/seed stability
stages.stop_rule: stop if class-dependent quantities are fit outside inner training roles or if common-class harm is material

stages.name: justified_extensions
stages.scientific_question: Do any unresolved ROI, causal-history, social or simple-fusion extensions add reproducible value after simpler controls?
stages.control: retained Stage 2-3 control with one extension changed
stages.confirmation_policy: confirm at most two extensions across two additional seeds
stages.promotion_rule: an extension enters the finalist only after a relevant hypothesis, matched control, support and predeclared retain rule pass
stages.stop_rule: do not implement or run FiLM, two-timescale history, Top-K, GAT or quality-gated fusion without registry authorization

compute.basis: extrapolated; implementation cost is excluded until authorized

stages.name: posture_auxiliary_ablation
stages.scientific_question: Does an independently reviewed and masked posture auxiliary head improve behavior recognition without harm?
stages.population: pooled_reviewed_population only if posture authority passes
stages.confirmation_policy: confirm only the retained behavior/posture decision across two additional seeds
stages.promotion_rule: posture is retained only with valid posture support/masking and no material behavior harm; posture remains separately reported
stages.stop_rule: block if posture authority, class order, transition handling or target alignment is unresolved

compute.basis: extrapolated; current posture authority is missing

stages.name: bounded_inner_autoresearch
stages.scientific_question: Within a frozen retained candidate family, which bounded configuration maximizes native-unit Macro-F1 under rare-class and efficiency constraints?
stages.changed_factor: one registered model, fusion, loss or hyperparameter family per trial
stages.promotion_rule: RETAIN, DROP or INCONCLUSIVE per trial; no automatic checkpoint promotion; freeze family, selection rule, thresholds and tie-breaks after the budget closes
stages.stop_rule: 24 trials, 48 GPU-hours, monetary cap, patience 6, per-trial timeout, failed-run ceiling 3, disk ceiling, or any outer-test access

compute.basis: bounded budget, to be recalibrated by E0

stages.name: claim_grade_grouped_outer_oof
stages.scientific_question: What is the independent grouped outer-fold native-unit performance of the frozen selected configuration?
stages.population: all eligible pooled reviewed native units under frozen outer folds
stages.control: frozen selection rule and candidate family; no new search
stages.promotion_rule: publish only after independent checker, NATIVE_UNITS_UNPREDICTED=0 or registered exclusions, frozen calibration and no outer-guided changes
stages.stop_rule: stop on any outer leakage, missing native prediction, fold-manifest drift or post-freeze semantic change

compute.basis: extrapolated from E0 and inner run envelope
